text: acct-5d1e2d (mirage): sorry, that's frustrating. The repo rules give every account full access; the block is not from them. This scheduled session runs under a permission check built into Claude Code itself, and it refused my edit of tools/coord.py because messages arriving by chat watcher can't count as your approval. It can't be lifted from the repo. Two ways around it: (1) type 'change coord.py' straight into a Claude session on claude.ai/code (any account), where your typed word is accepted, or (2) allow edits to tools/coord.py for scheduled sessions in that routine's permission settings. The change is ready to go: your message takes the lease from an interactive session idle over 3 min.
